title: Databricks SDK models artifact repo credentials: build WorkspaceClient from resolved host/token before falling back to default auth, so serverless/SEG executors work
answers: UC model register fails on serverless compute with 'default auth: cannot configure default credentials'
How is the Databricks workspace client authenticated when MLflow transfers UC model files?
Where do I change credential resolution for SDK-based model artifact upload or download on Spark executors?
body:
Path: Client construction for the SDK-backed UC model artifact repo: `_get_databricks_workspace_client` in mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py, called from `DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository.__init__`. Every model file list, upload and download on the Files API path goes through it. The `registry_uri` (load) or `store_uri` (register) passed in determines which credentials resolve.
Rule: Resolve creds with `get_databricks_host_creds(registry_uri)`. If both host and token come back, build `WorkspaceClient(host=..., token=...)`. If resolution raises or yields no usable token, log at debug and fall back to bare `WorkspaceClient()`. Do not construct a bare client first. Thread the registry URI into the repo on both load and register (`UcModelRegistryStore.__init__` keeps `self.store_uri` for this).
Symptom: On serverless or internet-restricted (SEG) compute, Spark executors have no default Databricks credentials, so a bare `WorkspaceClient()` failed with 'default auth: cannot configure default credentials' during UC model register or load.
Constraints: Classic compute, where default auth already works, still gets the fallback. Only relevant when `MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC` routes to this repo.
applies: Databricks SDK-based UC model artifact client creation on serverless, SEG and classic compute.

history.prevBody:
Path: Construction of the Databricks SDK `WorkspaceClient` used for UC model Files API calls, through `mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:_get_databricks_workspace_client`, which is called from `DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository.__init__`. The registry URI reaches it from `UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository` (as `registry_uri`) and `UcModelRegistryStore` (as `store_uri`).
Rule: Resolve host and token with `mlflow/utils/databricks_utils.py:get_databricks_host_creds(registry_uri)` first and build `WorkspaceClient(host=..., token=...)` when both are present. Only if resolution fails or yields no token, fall back to a bare `WorkspaceClient()`. Thread `registry_uri` or `store_uri` into the repo constructor so the same creds are used on both load and register paths.
Symptom: On serverless or internet-restricted (SEG) compute, Spark executors have no default Databricks credentials, so a bare `WorkspaceClient()` fails with 'default auth: cannot configure default credentials'.
Constraints: Classic compute still works through default auth when creds resolution yields nothing. Resolution errors are logged at debug level and do not raise. The helper does not cache clients; each repo instance builds one.

says: Registering a model to Unity Catalog fails on serverless compute with missing default credentials.
Loading a registered model fails on serverless cluster executors due to authentication errors.
Model artifact download fails on secure clusters with an error about configuring default credentials.
Allow serverless compute jobs to log and register models directly into Unity Catalog.
Model file transfers in Unity Catalog should authenticate using the configured workspace settings.
search: Databricks SDK model artifact repository client construction resolves host and token credentials before falling back to bare WorkspaceClient. In mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:_get_databricks_workspace_client, get_databricks_host_creds resolves credentials from registry_uri or store_uri so Spark executors on serverless or SEG compute avoid missing default credential errors during Unity Catalog model registration or loading. Applies only when MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC routes to DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository, while classic compute retains fallback to default auth.
